title: Library loans and inheritance
description: Define Book(title) with a private or protected title attribute and loan_days() returning 14. Define ReferenceBook inheriting Book and overriding loan_days() to return 0. Both classes must provide get_title(). Implement loan_periods(books) using polymorphic method calls to return each loan period.
hints: Put the shared constructor and getter in the parent class.
Call the same method on each object; do not branch on its type.
